question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "**diverse**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the** blank number 3** is **"diverse".**
 
• This is because the previous sentence mentions several reasons for migration, indicating that there are many factors at play when people decide to move.
 
• As a result, migration patterns are not uniform or constant, but rather diverse and variable.
 
• Because migration decisions are influenced by a variety of factors, the resulting patterns are diverse and complex.
